assessment_role: Frozen validation-selected main, not a new test-based version choice
optional_CIC17_role: Reported separately when requested; does not replace either required dataset

stagewise_protocol.average_incremental_accuracy: Unweighted mean of stage seen-class balanced accuracies
stagewise_protocol.calibration: Common permanent TRAIN Normal holdout at each stage; Section27.9 Normal-only tau extension for multiclass models; stored strict gate threshold for AA variants
stagewise_protocol.decomposition: For an attack class at its earliest maximum-recall preceding stage: change in unconditional Normal-miss rate plus change in other-attack-family rate equals signed recall loss
stagewise_protocol.forgetting: For each class introduced before the final task: maximum recall over preceding stages minus final recall; unweighted class mean; signed values retained
stagewise_protocol.prior: Original prepared TRAIN class frequencies, including permanently heldout rows; no TEST prior
stagewise_protocol.secondary_old_class_scope: Old attack classes only, excluding Normal
stagewise_protocol.seen_labels: Mask model outputs and TEST rows to the current seen classes
stagewise_protocol.selection: Earliest completed physical source per dataset/method/seed, never by metric

comparator_selection.tie_rule: First in the explicitly listed external set

tests.rule: Fail if candidate forgetting is significantly higher: one-sided p_greater < .05
Pass only if final BAcc is significantly higher than Replay-BS: one-sided p_greater < .05
Fail if alpha=.02 ADR is significantly lower than original AA: one-sided p_less < .05

comparator_selection.tie_rule: First in the explicitly listed external set

tests.rule: Fail if candidate forgetting is significantly higher: one-sided p_greater < .05
Pass only if final BAcc is significantly higher than Replay-BS: one-sided p_greater < .05
Fail if alpha=.02 ADR is significantly lower than original AA: one-sided p_less < .05

positioning: Lower false alarms and forgetting remain unresolved; AA-CIL is not claimed as the method contribution
test_definition: Unadjusted paired t tests on the five same-seed differences; candidate minus reference; p<.05. Lowest-forgetting external comparator selected by whole five-seed mean, with listed external order breaking ties
units: Metric values are fractions; delta_pp values are percentage points
limitations: Only saved stagewise metrics are consumed. No inference, training, checkpoint audit, or CM-metric recomputation is performed.
A failure to detect significant forgetting/ADR harm is not noninferiority or equivalence.
Known necessary-condition failure takes precedence over missing evidence. Incomplete five-seed groups never yield a test or lose a seed to obtain significance.
All five configurations, including ineligible fallbacks, remain in the descriptive report; formal test results do not change the frozen main selection.
External comparator selection and multiple unadjusted tests limit inferential claims.
The original Section27.8 and Section29.4 decisions are unchanged; this assessment is separately scoped to Section29.8.
